question: Did the GitHub repository ethereum/go-ethereum publish at least one stable release (not a draft, not a prerelease) with a published_at date in the last 30 days (720 hours)? Answer true or false.

definitions.calendar: At request time, resolve the latest already-finalized block once as toBlock.
